verdict.rationale: Publishing statutory fee amounts is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt probes that returned HTTP 403 on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing was fetched that shows whether fee schedules or amounts are published on the service's own pages, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form
